notes.title: Update 1.01 Version 190608
notes.content:
Our first patch based on feedback!

[list]
[*] Added perk reward on "Woody" ending
[*] Balanced tower defense stage 1 and 2
[*] Equalized audio levels on Hallowed sounds and Asylum music
[*] Fixed textures on rust, re-gen station, and missing textures
[*] Reduced ambient light on barrels
[*] Adjusted muzzle flash on projectile guns
[*] Foliage reduction
[/list]

Thank you for all your support and feedback!
